governingPrinciple: Do not generate any Mass icon until an actual source photograph or historical drawing of the exact action is recorded and the visual rules of the user-approved icon family are identified. Accuracy and harmony outrank coverage.

baseline.bank: Frozen v1.80 / v4.6 Mass bank plus individually accepted 2026-10-19 review decisions

referenceMasters.role: Celebrant silhouette, chalice geometry and composition
Celebrant clothing, gesture readability and approved detail level
Ceremonial family proportions and visual weight

requirements: Compare against actual approved donor art, not generated previews or an invented generic sacred-art style.
Match person anatomy, vestments, pose, viewpoint, composition, edges/stroke, contour, crop, tonal values and optical weight.
Keep essential object and hand placement clear at 32 and 48 pixels; do not shrink a complicated full church illustration into an icon.
Do not invent decor, ornate borders, additional candles, colorways or text labels absent from the approved family.
New visual assets must never overwrite the frozen source icon bank.
For monochrome UI masks, use true silhouettes or validated scalable vector with runtime theming; don't merely wrap a multicolour painting in SVG.

originalPicture.rule: An original image showing the actual ritual action is mandatory; a generated image, search thumbnail, artist prompt or rubric text is not an original picture. Preserve a documented copy and checksum of each original image. Unknown authorship requires explicit attribution status, never an invented name.
originalPicture.rights: Before transforming or reproducing any source picture, require documented clearance, suitable license or permission; image visibility is not publishing permission.

rubricWitness.canonical: Missale Romanum 1962, Ritus servandus in celebratione Missae
rubricWitness.section: X — The Lord's Prayer and everything else up to the end of Communion
rubricWitness.rule: Independently check actor, liturgical action, posture, both hands, vessels, objects, positions and timing. A photograph alone cannot certify 1962 accuracy.

visualAcceptance.rule: Side-by-side comparison with named, accepted Mass icon masters is required; no internal auto-approval.

observations: Celebrant holds both halves of the Sacred Host and the paten during the preparatory action.
Celebrant bows and rests his elbows on the altar to receive both halves.
This is the celebrant's own Communion at the altar, never distribution to a communicant.

candidates.note: Find and verify a real photograph or original documented drawing depicting the priest's own Communion before producing a new icon. Do not use imagery of the priest giving Communion.

observations: After signing himself with the chalice, celebrant holds the chalice with the right hand.
The paten is held underneath the chalice in his left hand.
Celebrant consumes the Precious Blood at the altar; this is not the chalice elevation.

candidates.note: Find and verify a real photograph or original documented drawing depicting the celebrant drinking from the chalice while supporting it with the paten.

excludedConcepts.reason: Generated from description without a specific authenticated original picture; not approved and not part of the frozen icon family.
Second illustrative mockup also lacked an authenticated original picture and approved-family comparison; not a production reference.

releaseRule: A generated Mass image cannot receive a reader icon key, appear in an approved asset overlay or be merged as production art unless its source originals, source rights, 1962 rubrical details, selected approved donor comparison, pixel-size proof and user approval are all independently satisfied.
